messages:
emma: Planning a staggered kernel + quantization profile push to prod tomorrow 09:00 PT. Aim: lower p99 tail with new kernels, quant profile optimized for chat workloads. Need owners for rollback + smoke for us-west-2 and us-east-1. PRs must land by 14:00 PT today.

raj: I can own rollback. Will be on-call during the window.

sasha: I can run smoke in us-west-2 (09:00 PT). Will verify latency, basic convo flows, and top-10 prompts.

liam: I'll watch metrics/dashboards and the tracing span heatmap. Can alert at 2% error rise or 30ms p50 regressed.

maria: Where's the preflight checklist? Also pinging @sasha — PR 4728 needs your review (perf test fix).

emma: checklist is here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/Kernel+Quant+Preflight (shortlink) -- main items: smoke script, rollback tag, canary config, infra slot claim.

deploy-bot: New deploy plan saved: deploy-plan-2026-03-18-09. Canary: 5% traffic, 30m observation. Owner: @emma.

raj: Rollback command for infra folks (keep handy):
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --deployment-id $DEPLOY_ID --target-tag v2026-03-17-kq-pre 
# or via console: Deployments > <id> > Rollback to tag
```

sasha: quick smoke checklist snippet:
- start smoke runner: `./smoke/run.sh --region us-west-2 --profile chat-short`
- check replies for hallucinations (top-20 prompts)
- verify token cost delta < 5%
- confirm kv-cache warmup within 2s

liam: dashboards: runtime/latency, runtime/errors, kv-cache/hits, canary/traffic. I added alerts: p99 > 600ms OR error-rate +2% sustained 5m.

maria: PRs: 4728 (perf fix) + 4735 (quant config). 4728 needs one more approve, 4735 is blocked on unit test rewrite. Emma, can we slip if tests not green?

emma: No slip. We need both. If 4735 doesn't land, fallback plan is to deploy kernel-only (no quant change) and then re-run quant in a patch. That requires a different tag: `v2026-03-18-kernel-only`.

raj: I'll prepare rollback tag and make sure deploy team has it. Will also be reachable on phone.

sasha: I'll run the smoke harness against canary after 10m of traffic and again at 25m. Post results as short bullets.

liam: small ask — who can own post-deploy quick eval (quality check on 50 prompts)? I can help but might be tied to alerts.

emma: sasha + liam split it. Sasha runs smoke functional; Liam runs sampling-based quality eval and cost metrics.

maria: tagging infra: @raj please confirm slot claim for west-2 (we usually reserve slot 7 for this kind of push).

raj: slot 7 reserved for 08:30-11:00 PT. I posted the claim in infra calendar.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout steps: initialize canary -> route 5% -> wait 30m -> promote if healthy. Automatic fallback enabled.

emma: small ops note: bring your laptop and have ssh keys ready for node-level checks. If fallback happens, we will cut traffic back and schedule a hotfix window.

sasha: I'll post smoke results in this thread with a one-line pass/fail and a short note if anything odd.

liam: I'll run the eval harness at +15m and +40m, will paste the small summary here.

maria: I'll keep a checklist checkbox file updated (short entries). And I'll gate the final prod flip — won't flip without both smoke + eval green.

emma: thanks all. Final timeline: 08:30 PT slot claim ready, 09:00 PT canary start, 09:30 PT mid-check, 09:40-10:00 PT promote if green. If anything fails, rollback owner (raj) executes rollback.

raj: ack. phone: +1-415-555-0192.

sasha: ack. pulling PR 4728 now, will aim to approve by 13:30 PT. :thumbsup:

liam: ack, will standby.

maria: ack, will gate.

emma: thanks — please react with :eyes: when you see the preflight link and :white_check_mark: when you've completed your preflight steps.

sasha: :eyes:

raj: :white_check_mark:

liam: :eyes:

maria: :white_check_mark:

emma: thread closed for updates — post final green here.
